questions.question:
Quality A and B rice, valued at Rs 35 per kg and Rs 65 per kg respectively, are mixed. The new average price of the mixture obtained is Rs 50 per kg. What is the ratio of the quantity of A and B in the mixture?

A. 1 : 2

B. 1 : 3

C. 1 : 1

D. 1 : 5
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of A = Rs 35 per kg

Cost price of B = Rs 65 per kg

The average price of the mixture = 50 per kg

**Calculation:**

Let the total quantity of rice be X kg.

Total cost price = 50 × X = 50X

Let the quantity of rice of variety A = A kg

Then, the quantity of rice of variety B = (X - A) kg

Total cost price of variety A = 35 × A = 35A

Total cost price of variety B = 65 × (X - A) kg

65(X - A) + 35A = 50X

15X = 30A

Or, X/A = 2/1

The ratio of variety A to variety B = A/(X - A) = 1/(2 - 1) 

Ratio of A to B = 1 ∶ 1

**∴ The required ratio is 1 ∶ 1.**

questions.question:
The mean of a distribution is 24 and the standard deviation is 6. What is the value of variance coefficient?

A. 50%

B. 25%

C. 100%

D. 75%
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Mean of the distribution = 24

Standard deviation = 6

**Concept used:**

Coefficient of variance = standard deviation/mean × 100

**Calculation:**

Coefficient of variance = 6/24 × 100 = 100/4

Coefficient of variance = 25%

**∴ The coefficient of variance is 25%.**

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **unit digit** of any number ending in **1** remains **1** for all positive integer powers.

Unit digit of (3451)⁵¹ → 1⁵¹ = 1

Unit digit of (531)⁴³ → 1⁴³ = 1

**Given Expression:** (3451)⁵¹ × (531)⁴³

To find the **unit digit** of a product, we only need to consider the unit digits of the individual bases and their respective powers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b437a330eb0fa578e61446ad173c0a502bfc7b43de996ec745cd0e7b75bca92a.png]

Cyclicity of 0, 1, 5, 6

Numbers ending in 0, 1, 5, or 6 have a **cyclicity of 1**. This means the unit digit remains the same regardless of the power (e.g., 5ⁿ always ends in 5).

Cyclicity of 4 and 9

These numbers have a **cyclicity of 2**. For 4, the unit digit is 4 if the power is odd and 6 if even. For 9, it is 9 if the power is odd and 1 if even.

Cyclicity of 2, 3, 7, 8

These numbers have a **cyclicity of 4**. To find the unit digit, divide the power by 4 and use the remainder as the new power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Job promotion**

 
 
• **Job Enrichment** **or** Job promotion is a job design technique that varies the concept of job enlargement.
 
• Job enrichment adds new sources of job satisfaction by increasing the level of responsibility of the employee in an organization.
 
• While** job enlargement** is considered as a** horizontal restructuring method, job enrichment or **Job promotion **is considered as a vertical restructuring method** of the moral excellence of giving the employee additional authority, autonomy, and control over the way the job is accomplished.
 
 
• Also called** job enhancement or vertical job expansion.**
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, option 1 is correct__.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Methods or Techniques of Job Design**

 
 
• Job Rotation
 
• Job Enrichment
 
• Job Enlargement
 
 
 
• **Advantages of job enrichment**
 
 
• **Interesting and challenging job**:-
 
 
• When a certain amount of power is given to employees it makes the job more challenging for them, we can say that job enrichment is a method of employee empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Improves decision making**:-
 
 
• Through job enrichment, we can improve the decision-making ability of the employee.
 
 
 
• **Reduces workload of superiors**:-
 
 
• Job enrichment reduces the workload of senior staff. When decisions are taken by juniors the senior's workload is reduced.
